expectation: Cytoplasmic stain in a subset of myeloid cells (DCs, some macrophages) and activated endothelium. Uncommon overall, but enriched in inflamed stroma and immune aggregates as scattered or clustered bright cells, and some vessel-lining cells. Tumour nests and most of the tissue should be negative.
observed: A: discrete bright cells, dense in a few stromal/immune patches in some images and sparse or absent in others. B and C are nearly empty. D: one elongated, vessel- or DC-like cytoplasmic cell. E1: crisp, bright, distinct cells. E3: some sit on CD163 cells, many are CD163-negative.
why: Discrete, cell-shaped cytoplasmic positives cluster in immune-rich stroma and vary between images. This does not follow cell density or the tissue outline, so it is a specific population.
notes: Ido1 marks crisp single cells clustered in inflamed stromal patches, and empty fields elsewhere. Only some sit on CD163 macrophages; others are likely DCs or endothelium, which fits Ido1 biology.
